heading_en: Validation of the Internal Rating System Using External Data
summary_ja: 前条以外の定量的検証手法と外部データとの比較、及びその手法の性質を定める。
summary_en: Requires quantitative validation methods beyond back-testing and comparison with external data sources, and sets four characteristics of such methods.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall use quantitative validation methods other than the validation methods prescribed in each paragraph of the preceding Article, and shall make comparisons with relevant external data sources.

The validation methods referred to in the preceding paragraph shall satisfy all of the following characteristics: (i) the data used in the analysis is appropriate for the portfolio being analyzed, is updated regularly, and covers the relevant observation period; (ii) they are based on long-run historical data; (iii) they are not structurally affected by the business cycle; (iv) documents on changes to validation methods, data sources or the covered period have been prepared.
